# Wavey

> Wavey is an AI engine and collaborative platform for modern software development and agent workflows. It allows developers and teams to design, build, and optimize AI agents, applications, and workflows.

## Features
- **Agent Orchestration**: Build, deploy, and monitor autonomous AI agents.
- **Enterprise Controls**: Role-based access control, audit logs, scoped secrets, and SOC 2 compliance.
- **Cost Optimization**: Optimize model latency and token costs with self-improving prompt loops.
- **Developer Workspace**: Real-time collaborative chat and coding canvas powered by advanced LLMs.
